policy.payloads: Metadata only. No firmware, BIOS, key or ROM bytes and no links to proprietary payloads. Hashes identify user-supplied dumps imported with `bep firmware:import`.

need.required: emulator refuses to boot without it

need.lle-only: only needed by a low-level emulation path
need.not-used: documented for identification; emulators HLE it
need.required-for-encrypted-media: only needed to decrypt retail containers
need.required-for-addon: only needed by the add-on hardware named in the role

vendoredStates.in-tree: bytes or source are present in this checkout
vendoredStates.pinned-submodule-not-checked-out: the gitlink is pinned but not initialized in this checkout
